therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: HER2 receptor antagonism combined with antimetabolite chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: HER2-driven tumor cell proliferation and survival

results.dose_information: Gemcitabine 1250 mg/m2 IV day 1 every 3 weeks for 6 cycles; Trastuzumab 8 mg/kg IV first cycle then 6 mg/kg for 5 cycles; Capecitabine 1250 mg/m2 b.i.d p.o days 1-14 every 3 weeks for 6 cycles
